notes: Version 0.1.9. Performance patch: eliminated constant idle jank by gating the level-up modal animations to only run while visible and making the cursor-glow and streak-shield effect loops idle-aware, plus fixed a startup error that could skip initial UI refresh. Also fixes the timer preset buttons' lower hit area (timer display overlapped them) and removes their inconsistent hover border. Includes the earlier UI polish: Notes pagination, aligned scroll fades, consistent 8px spacing, balanced 16px spacing around the timer session indicator, restyled preset/gear/pager controls, refined disabled timer-button styling, and a subtler click-shrink effect.
